items.title: Sister Bernice Phillips Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: Yes, indeed, I know George. George used to play with my husband.

ctx.x: Oh, I know who you're talking about. He died too?

Yeah. Lawrence. Lawrence. Lawrence and Howard. George McCullough, George Lewis, my husband. And the fella used to play the drums. That little fella named Happy. Well. And then they had another one. He lived up here on Hall Street somewhere. Now he's a drunker. He used to play with them when he couldn't get happy. They would be leaving on a Saturday evening like this to go way down in Bali to play for the white folks. Well, they'd come over there and they'd start to drink. I'd be, have the fried pork chop and make…
They'd stay over there. They'd stay over there.
